neighbours.label: the article just before the instrument or agency that carries out a technical procedure: 'with a ...', 'using a ...', 'by passing a ...'
fire: The dentist removes the plaque from below the gumline with a small metal scraper.
A biopsy is performed by passing a thin hollow needle through the skin.
The veterinarian opens the blocked duct using a fine catheter.
Soil samples are gathered by a handheld corer consisting of a steel tube.
The eye surgeon makes a tiny cut in the cornea with a diamond blade.
The new technique for slicing silicon uses a thin heated wire.
The probe was built by a joint team from NASA and the Japanese space agency.
The clot is removed through a small incision with a flexible wire basket.
quiet: The dentist lives below the clinic with a large noisy family.
A birthday is celebrated by passing a big slice of cake around the room.
The veterinarian opens the clinic on Saturday with a cheerful greeting.
Soil samples are described in a short report consisting of a single table.
The eye surgeon makes a tiny profit in the summer with a rental flat.
The new technique for slicing bread has a devoted following online.
The probe was praised by a retired writer from Ohio and the local paper.
The clot was mentioned in a short note with a friendly apology.

notes: Russian pieces also fire in the corpus ('из' of 'измерения', 0.64 in a probe); this test covers English only.
